description: This Kotlin source file defines the SplashActivity class, which manages the splash screen shown at app startup. It utilizes Android's SplashScreen API on Android 12+ and provides fallback behavior for older versions, displaying a branded splash with a wordmark for 3 seconds before launching MainActivity.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a branded splash screen for 3 seconds during app startup, handling both Android 12+ and pre-Android 12 devices. It uses the SplashScreen API for newer versions and a Handler delay for older versions before navigating to MainActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash activity, installs the splash screen if supported, sets the content view, and manages delayed navigation to MainActivity based on Android version.

methods.name: navigateToMain
methods.description: Navigates from the splash screen to the main activity and finishes the splash activity.
